en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammānulomapaccanīya (3), Tikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (1) 13.5.
Saṅkiliṭṭhattika (The Triplet of the Corrupted)
Dependent on a state that is both defiled and subject to defilement, a state that is not defiled but subject to defilement arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*).
Dependent on a state that is both defiled and subject to defilement, a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement [arises].

[It] arises by way of root-condition (*hetupaccaya*). Dependent on a defiled and defiling state (*saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesika*), a state that is neither defiled nor defiling (*naasaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesika*) arises by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a defiled and defiling state, states that are both neither defiled nor defiling and not defiled-and-defiling arise by way of root-condition. [Dependent on] a defiled and defiling state...

Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement, states that are neither defiled nor subject to defilement and states that are not defiled but subject to defilement arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is not defiled but subject to defilement, a state that is not defiled but subject to defilement arises.
By way of root condition: dependent on a state that is not defiled but subject to defilement, a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is not defiled but subject to defilement, states that are both not defiled but subject to defilement and neither defiled nor subject to defilement arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement, a state that is not undefiled and not subject to defilement arises by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement, a state that is not defiled but subject to defilement arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement, a state that is not undefiled and not subject to defilement...

A state arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement, states that are both not defiled and subject to defilement and neither defiled nor subject to defilement arise by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement, states that are both not defiled and subject to defilement and neither defiled nor subject to defilement arise by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-defiled-nor-objects-of-defilement and a state that is defiled, a state that is neither-defiled-nor-objects-of-defilement arises by way of root-condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is defiled and a state that is neither-defiled-nor-objects-of-defilement, a state that is neither-defiled-nor-objects-of-defilement arises by way of root-condition … [etc. … three. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are nineteen;
under object-condition nine … [etc. … under resultant-condition eleven … [etc. … under non-disappearance-condition nineteen. (The Section on Co-nascence is also [to be expanded].)

The section on conditions (*paccayavāra*), the section on dependence (*nissayavāra*), the section on association (*saṃsaṭṭhavāra*), and the section on conjunction (*sampayuttavāra*) should also be expanded in detail. [However,] it is not the same in the section on inquiry (*pañhāvāra*).

Under root-cause (*hetu*): thirteen; under object-condition (*ārammaṇa*): fifteen; under predominance-condition (*adhipati*): fifteen; under proximity-condition (*anantara*): sixteen... pe ... under co-nascence-condition (*sahajāta*): [sixteen].

Nineteen with respect to root-cause; nine with respect to mutuality; twenty-six with respect to support; seventeen with respect to decisive support; six with respect to prenascence; nine with respect to postnascence;

eight with respect to repetition; thirteen with respect to kamma; eight with respect to result; thirteen with respect to nutriment … pe … thirteen with respect to the path; nine with respect to association;
twelve with respect to dissociation … pe … twenty-six with respect to non-disappearance.
